A '''sleep-cocoon''' was a type of portable sleeping equipment. Fans of the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] used sleep-cocoons to camp overnight outside the [[Holosseum]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in advance of her performance there in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].
